title: ceiba casearia
intro: Ceiba casearia, commonly known as the Kapok tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malvaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
